sections.title: Content
content: This system automatically converts Markdown files to JSON format optimized for AI consumption.
- **md-to-json.js** - Node.js script that converts Markdown to JSON
- **md-to-json.bat** - Windows batch script to run the converter
- **start-md-to-json-watcher.bat** - Script to start the watcher in background
- **start-md-to-json-silent.vbs** - Silent runner for Windows Task Scheduler
